name: Tracing the Source
label: Quest
description: Tracing the Source: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something's wrong with my product? Well, I've never seen so many people wanting something so badly.
I bought my supply from a merchant named Mara Rennick. She's new in town.
She mentioned she had some goods she had to deliver to the tailor in the Mage Quarter.
